cohort: The study included 63 human amniotic fluid samples from isolated CDH cases (n=33) and Cesarean section cases without fetal complications (controls, n=30).
finding: Amniotic fluid LCN2 levels were significantly lower in CDH cases compared to controls and showed a significant positive correlation with the observed/expected lung-to-head ratio, indicating LCN2 as a potential biomarker for fetal lung hypoplasia in CDH.
cross-section timing: Amniotic fluid samples were obtained at the time of Cesarean section, performed after 35-38 gestational weeks.
gest_age: Samples were obtained from pregnancies after 35-38 gestational weeks.
